## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? Describe the use case.

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternatives Considered
Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## Mockups / Examples
If applicable, add mockups, wireframes, or examples from other apps.

## Additional Context
Any other context or information about the feature request.

## Implementation Notes
If you have technical insights on how this could be implemented.

## Priority
- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Important
- [ ] Critical
